properties.volume_resistivity: Bulk resistance to current flow; test geometry and conditioning required.
properties.surface_resistivity: Surface leakage resistance; contamination and humidity matter.
properties.dielectric_strength: Breakdown field under a specified test method and geometry.
properties.relative_permittivity: Relative dielectric constant; frequency and temperature dependent.
properties.dissipation_factor: Dielectric loss; frequency, temperature and conditioning dependent.
properties.tracking_resistance: Resistance to surface tracking under the applicable method.
properties.arc_resistance: Resistance to electrical arc exposure under the applicable method.
